summary: Completed comprehensive multi-tenant isolation testing for GestorEPI system - all isolation requirements verified and working correctly
passed_tests: Authentication for all user types (empresa1_admin, empresa2_admin, superadmin)
Supplier isolation - empresa A cannot see empresa B suppliers
Same CNPJ allowed in different companies for suppliers
Duplicate CNPJ blocked within same company for suppliers
Employee isolation - empresa A cannot see empresa B employees
Same CPF allowed in different companies for employees
Duplicate CPF blocked within same company for employees
EPI isolation - empresa A cannot see empresa B EPIs
EPI creation and management per company
Delivery isolation - companies can only see their own deliveries
Delivery endpoint access control working correctly
Dashboard isolation - each company sees only their data
SuperAdmin can access all companies and master dashboard
Cross-company resource access properly blocked (404 errors)
Multi-tenant authentication with proper empresa_id assignment
Company-specific data filtering in all endpoints
Facial recognition requirement for deliveries (expected behavior)
